pure-announcement.rationale: This is a docs.rs API reference capture, not a launch, release note or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: None of the nearest concepts (skills format, OSV, code graphs, context layer, MCP detection) cover linting AI-generated code slop.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The crate is a public, installable primary source whose detection behaviour anyone can run and check.

durability.rationale: The bulk is a version-pinned rustdoc module/struct index that churns with releases; only the four-part slop taxonomy (placeholder, deferral, hedging, stub) would still matter in a year.

actionability.rationale: The only action available is adopting this specific crate — product-only steps with no transferable guidance on how or when to lint for AI slop.

atomicity.rationale: It is one idea — a linter that pattern-matches AI-generated slop categories — statable in a single paragraph.
